settings.title: MCP server
settings.description: Lets Claude and other MCP clients work with this installation as the signed-in user, with that user's permissions only.
settings.enabledHint: Off: /mcp answers “not found” and no client can connect.
settings.dcrHint: Claude and other clients register automatically; only the redirect hosts below are accepted.
settings.hostsHint: One per line. Loopback addresses always need to be listed (localhost, 127.0.0.1). * allows any host.
settings.rateLimit: Tool calls per user per minute
settings.approveWarning: Approve tools let a client record the user's own approval decisions. They are off by default; turn them on only if your policy allows it.
settings.revokeDescription: “{{client}}” loses access at once for every user. It can register again later.
settings.guideText: In Claude (Settings → Connectors) or Claude Code (claude mcp add --transport http strategy <address>), add this address. The first time, the user signs in here and allows the connection. A personal access token with the “MCP” scope works too.

consent.title: Allow {{client}} to use your account?
consent.description: The application “{{client}}” asks to connect to this system as you.
consent.canRead: read the records, approvals and notifications you can see
consent.canAct: use only the tools your administrator has turned on
consent.cannot: It will not be able to see more than you can, and every call is recorded in the audit log.
consent.redirect: After you choose, you return to {{host}}.
consent.notFound: This connection request is not valid. Start again from your AI client.
consent.disabled: The MCP server is switched off.

errors.disabled: The MCP server is switched off.
errors.consentRefused: The connection could not be allowed.

validation.host: Enter host names only, e.g. claude.ai.
